answer: Sybils must fund a fresh deposit and repeat the full voyage per fake reputation slot, so forging N identities costs N times the stake plus gas and verification time, making mass duplicate accounts economically irrational. Each agent must stake a violet-bonded deposit and complete a randomized voyage task whose route is seeded by its on-chain history, then publish a signed echo of the result that peers cross-verify. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
